ai.summary: The page https://oceana.org/ loaded over HTTPS with HTTP 200 in a headless browser. The FundraiseUp installation code was not found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request was recorded. The verdict status is not_installed, with the reason that installation code is missing. Google Tag Manager container GTM-NGMV83 was found, three GA4 measurement IDs were found, and the Meta Pixel was loaded. CookieYes was found as the consent tool. Engaging Networks is linked from the page, with a link to a waystogive page. The donate page at https://oceana.org/resources/ways-to-give-donate-now/ returns HTTP 200 with donation content in the HTML. The browser did not click any buttons, so this check does not show whether any checkout or donate button works. Three console errors were recorded, and one request failed to resolve.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to set up donations on oceana.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us on your online donation setup. We checked https://oceana.org/ and the installation code for the donation platform is not in the page source yet.

Please add the installation code to the page at https://oceana.org/ so it loads on the page. Once it is added, let us know and we will run the check again.

We also found links to Engaging Networks on the page. Please tell us whether those links should stay in place.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
